title: Help text, summarize and the READMEs still describe the build-time max query length
body:
Commit b3f9104 removed the build-time max query length, and commit 01aa478 added `--memory-budget`. Three pieces of user-facing text have not caught up.

- The `--write-lcp` help on `CreateArgs` in `sufr/src/lib.rs` says the LCP array "speeds up query-time max query lengths shorter than the build-time value". No build-time value exists now. The LCP array is still read when a search with `-m` subsamples a file that has one.
- `summarize` prints a "Max query len" row for every file without a seed mask, from `Metadata::summary` in `libsufr/src/typed.rs`. The value is always 0 on a file refactor can open.
- Neither `README.md` nor `sufr/README.md` mentions `--memory-budget`.

## Open

- Whether the "Max query len" row goes away, or becomes a row that names the sort, unmasked or the mask. `SuffixSortType::MaxQueryLen` is still public with 0 as its only valid value, so dropping the row may raise whether that variant stays.
